units.en: Zhao Yanshou, Ru defense commissioner, became Heyang commissioner; Liu Zan, Bureau of Revenue director and edict drafter, became Secretariat drafting officer; Cheng Xun, Heyang secretary, became Bureau of Revenue vice director and edict drafter; Li Dechong of Dai became Yu prefect.
units.literal: Ruzhou defense commissioner Zhao Yanshou was made Heyang military commissioner; Bureau of Revenue director and edict drafter Liu Zan was made Secretariat drafting officer; Heyang secretary Cheng Xun was made Bureau of Revenue vice director and edict drafter; Dai prefect Li Dechong was made Yu prefect.

units.zh: 以奉國左右廂都指揮使郭謹為侍衛親軍步軍都指揮使、夔州寧江軍節度使。
units.en: and Guo Jin, commander of the left and right wings of the Fengguo Army, was appointed commander of the palace guard foot soldiers and military governor of the Ningjiang Army at Kui Prefecture.
units.literal: Guo Jin, Commander-in-Chief of the Left and Right Wings of the Fengguo Army, was appointed Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Guard Foot Soldiers and Military Governor of the Ningjiang Army of Kui Prefecture.

units.zh: 辛未，以鄴都留守杜威為北面行營都招討使，以侍衛親軍都指揮使、鄆州節度使李守貞為兵馬都監，兗州安審琦為左右廂都指揮使，徐州符彥卿為馬軍左廂都指揮使，滑州皇甫遇為馬軍右廂都指揮使，貝州梁漢璋為馬軍都排陣使，前鄧州宋彥筠為步軍左廂都指揮使，奉國左廂都指揮使王饒為步軍右廂都指揮使，洺州團練使薛懷讓為先鋒都指揮使。
units.en: On xinwei Du Wei, military governor of Yedu, was appointed overall commander of the northern field army; Li Shouzhen, commander of the Imperial Guard and military governor of Yunzhou, became overall supervisor of troops and horses; An Shenqi of Yanzhou commanded both wings; Fu Yanqing of Xuzhou the left wing of cavalry; Huangfu Yu of Huazhou the right wing of cavalry; Liang Hanzhang of Beizhou marshal of the cavalry array; Song Yanyun, former prefect of Dengzhou, the left wing of infantry; Wang Rao of the Fengguo left wing the right wing of infantry; and Xue Huairang, regimental trainer of Mozhou, vanguard commander.
units.literal: On xinwei Du Wei, military governor of Yedu, was made overall commander of the Northern Circuit field headquarters; Li Shouzhen, commander of the Imperial Guard and military governor of Yanzhou, was made overall supervisor of troops and horses; An Shenqi of Yanzhou was made commander of both wings; Fu Yanqing of Xuzhou was made commander of the left wing of the horse army; Huangfu Yu of Huazhou was made commander of the right wing of the horse army; Liang Hanzhang of Beizhou was made marshal of the horse army array; Song Yanyun, former prefect of Dengzhou, was made commander of the left wing of the foot army; Wang Rao, commander of the left wing of the Fengguo army, was made commander of the right wing of the foot army; Xue Huairang, regimental trainer of Mozhou, was made vanguard commander.

units.zh: 丁酉，詔李守貞知幽州行府事。
units.en: On dingyou Li Shouzhen was ordered to administer the mobile headquarters at Youzhou.
units.literal: On dingyou an edict made Li Shouzhen administrator of the mobile office at Youzhou.

units.zh: 壬申，始聞杜威、李守貞等以此月十日率諸軍降於契丹。
units.en: On renshen came the first report that on the tenth Du Wei, Li Shouzhen, and the rest had surrendered the armies to the Khitans.
units.literal: On renshen word was first received that on the tenth of this month Du Wei, Li Shouzhen, and the others had led the armies in surrender to the Khitans.

units.zh: 以前邠州節度使安叔千為滄州節度使。
units.en: An Shuqian, former military governor of Bin Prefecture, was appointed military governor of Cang Prefecture.
units.literal: An Shuqian, former Military Governor of Bin Prefecture, was appointed Military Governor of Cang Prefecture.

units.zh: 以左拾遺、直樞密院李崧充樞密直學士。
units.en: Left Reminder Li Song, direct privy councilor, became privy council academician.
units.literal: Left Reminder and direct privy councilor Li Song became privy council academician.

units.zh: 庚寅，樞密使、中書侍郎兼戶部尚書、平章事馮玉加尚書右僕射，以皇子鎮寧軍節度使延煦為陜州節度使，以陜州留後焦繼勛為鳳翔留後，以前定州留後安審琦為邠州留後，以右僕射和凝為左僕射。
units.en: On gengyin Feng Yu, Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, Vice Director of the Secretariat, concurrent Minister of Revenue, and Grand Counsellor, was promoted to Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Prince Yanxu, military governor of Zhenning, became military governor of Shanzhou; Jiao Jixun, acting prefect of Shanzhou, acting prefect of Fengxiang; An Shenqi, former acting prefect of Dingzhou, acting prefect of Binzhou; and He Ning moved from Right to Left Vice Director.
units.literal: On gengyin Feng Yu, Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of Revenue and Grand Counsellor, was advanced to Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; the prince Yanxu, military governor of Zhenning army, was made military governor of Shanzhou; Jiao Jixun, acting prefect of Shanzhou, was made acting prefect of Fengxiang; An Shenqi, former acting prefect of Dingzhou, was made acting prefect of Binzhou; He Ning, Right Vice Director, was made Left Vice Director.

units.zh: 是夜，偵知張彥澤已至滑州，召李崧、馮玉、李彥韜入內計事，方議詔河東劉知遠起兵赴難，至五鼓初，張彥澤引蕃騎入京。
units.en: That night scouts reported Zhang Yanzhe at Huazhou; Li Song, Feng Yu, and Li Yantao were called in to deliberate and were debating an edict for Liu Zhiyuan of Hedong to march to the rescue when at the fifth watch Zhang Yanzhe led Khitan cavalry into the capital.
units.literal: That night scouts learned Zhang Yanzhe had reached Huazhou; Li Song, Feng Yu, and Li Yantao were summoned within to plan; they were just discussing an edict for Liu Zhiyuan of Hedong to raise troops to the rescue when at the first watch of the fifth drum Zhang Yanzhe led barbarian cavalry into the capital.

units.zh: 宰臣趙瑩、樞密使馮玉、侍衛馬軍都指揮使李彥韜隨帝入蕃，契丹主遣三百騎援送而去。
units.en: Grand Counsellor Zhao Ying, Commissioner Feng Yu, and Li Yantao, commander of the Imperial Guard cavalry, accompanied the emperor into Khitan territory while the Khitan lord sent three hundred horsemen as escort.
units.literal: Grand Counsellor Zhao Ying, Commissioner Feng Yu, and Li Yantao, commander of the Imperial Guard horse army, followed the Emperor into the barbarians; the Khitan lord sent three hundred cavalry to escort and send them off.

units.zh: 以潁州團練使高行周為安北都護，充振武節度使。
units.en: Gao Xingzhou, Yingzhou training commissioner, became Protector-General of Pacifying the North and Zhenwu commissioner.
units.literal: Yingzhou training commissioner Gao Xingzhou was made Protector-General of Pacifying the North and Zhenwu military commissioner.

units.zh: 王周，魏州人。
units.en: Wang Zhou was a native of Weizhou.
units.literal: Wang Zhou was a man of Weizhou.

units.zh: 少勇健，從軍事唐莊宗、明宗，稍遷裨校，以戰功累歷郡守。
units.en: As a young man he was vigorous and daring. He served under Emperors Zhuangzong and Mingzong of Tang, rose step by step through the officer ranks, and with repeated victories held one prefectural post after another.
units.literal: In youth he was brave and strong; he followed the armies in service to Tang Emperors Zhuangzong and Mingzong, was gradually promoted to staff officer, and through battle achievements successively held prefectural governorships.

units.zh: 晉天福初，範延光叛於魏州，周從楊光遠攻降之，安重榮以鎮州叛，從杜重威討平之，以功授貝州節度使。
units.en: Early in the Jin Tianfu reign, Fan Yanguang rebelled in Weizhou and Zhou joined Yang Guangyuan in the campaign that brought him down. When An Chongrong rose in Zhenzhou, Zhou followed Du Chongwei to crush that revolt and, for these services, was made military commissioner of Beizhou.
units.literal: At the beginning of the Jin Tianfu era, Fan Yanguang rebelled at Weizhou; Zhou followed Yang Guangyuan to attack and subdue him. An Chongrong rebelled with Zhenzhou; he followed Du Chongwei to suppress and pacify him, and for merit was appointed military commissioner of Beizhou.

units.zh: 乾祐元年二月，以疾卒於鎮，輟視朝二日，贈中書令。
units.en: In the second month of Qianyou 1 he died of illness in office. The court suspended audiences for two days and posthumously appointed him Director of the Secretariat.
units.literal: In the second month of the first year of Qianyou he died of illness at his post; court audiences were suspended for two days, and he was posthumously made Zhongshu Ling.

units.zh: 先是，前帥張彥澤在任苛虐，部民逃者五千餘戶，及下車，革前弊二十餘事，逃民歸復，賜詔褒美。
units.en: His predecessor Zhang Yanzhe had ruled with harsh cruelty, and more than five thousand households had fled the prefecture. When Zhou arrived he abolished more than twenty longstanding abuses, the refugees came back, and the court issued an edict commending his administration.
units.literal: Previously the former commander Zhang Yanzhe had been harsh and cruel in office; more than five thousand households of the district had fled. When Zhou took up his post, he reformed more than twenty abuses of the past, the fugitive people returned, and an edict was bestowed praising him.

units.zh: 初刺信都，州城西橋敗，覆民租車，周曰：「橋梁不飭，刺史之過也。」
units.en: Early in his tenure at Xindu the west bridge of the city collapsed and overturned carts carrying the people's grain tax. Zhou said, "When bridges are left in disrepair, the fault lies with the prefect."
units.literal: When he first governed Xindu, the west bridge of the prefectural city collapsed and overturned the people's grain-tax carts. Zhou said: "Bridges not maintained are the prefect's fault."

units.zh: 事不獲已，乃見契丹主，授鄧州節度使、檢校太師。
units.en: When there was no alternative he went before the Khitan emperor and was given the posts of military commissioner of Dengzhou and honorary Grand Preceptor.
units.literal: The matter could not be helped; he then saw the Khitan ruler and was appointed military commissioner of Dengzhou and honorary Grand Preceptor.

units.zh: 高祖定天下，移鎮徐州，加同平章事。
units.en: After Gaozu secured the empire, Zhou was reassigned to Xuzhou and made a co-director of the Secretariat.
units.literal: When Gaozu settled the realm, Zhou was transferred to garrison Xuzhou and given the additional title of Tongping Zhangshi.

units.zh: 歲餘，移鎮涇州。
units.en: A little over a year later he was reassigned to Jingzhou.
units.literal: After more than a year, he was transferred to garrison Jingzhou.

units.zh: 陽城之役，周時為定州節度使，大軍往來，供饋無闕，未幾，遷鎮州節度使。
units.en: During the battle at Yangcheng he was military commissioner of Dingzhou and kept the armies supplied without fail as they marched back and forth. Soon afterward he was moved to Zhenzhou.
units.literal: In the Yangcheng campaign, Zhou was then military commissioner of Dingzhou; as the great army came and went, provisions were supplied without shortage. Before long he was transferred to military commissioner of Zhenzhou.

units.zh: 開運末，杜重威降於契丹，引契丹主臨城諭之。
units.en: Late in the Kaiyun era Du Chongwei surrendered to the Khitan and brought the Khitan emperor to the walls to urge the garrison to submit.
units.literal: At the end of Kaiyun, Du Chongwei surrendered to the Khitan; he brought the Khitan ruler to the city to announce and persuade them.

units.zh: 周泣曰：「受國重恩，不能死戰，而以兵降，何面南行見人主與士大夫乎？」
units.en: Zhou wept and said, "The state has shown me great favor, yet I could not die fighting and instead surrendered my troops. How can I face south and go before the emperor and the court?"
units.literal: Zhou wept and said: "Having received the state's heavy grace, I could not die in battle but instead surrender with troops—what face have I to go south and see the sovereign and the scholar-officials?"

units.zh: 乃痛飲欲引決，家人止之。
units.en: He drank deeply, intending to kill himself, but his household stopped him.
units.literal: He then drank heavily intending to take his own life, but his family restrained him.

units.zh: 周稟性寬惠，人庶便之。
units.en: By nature Zhou was lenient and benevolent, and the common people flourished under him.
units.literal: Zhou's nature was generous and kind; the people found him convenient.

units.zh: 周性寬恕，不忤物情。
units.en: Zhou was forbearing by nature and never set himself against popular sentiment.
units.literal: Zhou's disposition was forgiving and did not go against people's feelings.
